paper.title: WeatherBench: A benchmark dataset for data-driven weather forecasting
paper.authors: Stephan Rasp, Peter D. Dueben, Sebastian Scher et al.

thesis: We hope that this dataset will accelerate research in data-driven weather forecasting.

reconstruction.scope: abstract-level graph with retained full text

nodes.title: Research question
nodes.body: How can the target scientific task be compared under fixed data and evaluation rules?

nodes.title: Freeze tasks and metrics
nodes.body: First studies show promise but the lack of a common dataset and evaluation metrics make inter-comparison between studies difficult.

nodes.title: Evaluate reference systems
nodes.body: We provide data derived from the ERA5 archive that has been processed to facilitate the use in machine learning models.

nodes.title: Primary reported result
nodes.body: Here we present a benchmark dataset for data-driven medium-range weather forecasting, a topic of high scientific interest for atmospheric and computer scientists alike.

nodes.title: Published conclusion
nodes.body: We hope that this dataset will accelerate research in data-driven weather forecasting.
